extDescription.message: Removes tracking parameters from links, skips redirectors and blocks tracking domains. Uses the ClearURLs rules.

cmdCopy.message: Copy the clean URL of the current tab

errHashFormat.message: The rules hash file does not contain a valid SHA-256.

errHashMismatch.message: The downloaded rules do not match their hash. Nothing was changed.

errRulesFormat.message: The downloaded file is not in the ClearURLs rules format.

menuOpenLink.message: Open clean link in new tab

menuCopyPage.message: Copy clean URL of this page

popupOff.message: Protection is off. Links are not being cleaned.

popupUnsupported.message: This page can’t be cleaned (internal browser and extension store pages).

welcomeTitle.message: Done. Your links now come out clean.

welcomeText.message: LinkLimpo strips from the address whatever only exists to track you, and leaves the rest untouched. It works on its own; there is nothing to set up.

opt_cleanLinks_desc.message: Cleans a link when you hover, click or use “Copy link address”, before you leave the page.

opt_redirectSkipping_desc.message: Goes straight to the destination for links like google.com/url?q=…, l.facebook.com and Outlook Safe Links.

opt_historyCleaning_desc.message: Removes tracking that the site adds to the address bar after loading (history API).

opt_domainBlocking_desc.message: Blocks domains that exist only to track or serve ads, such as googlesyndication.com.

opt_pingBlocking_desc.message: Stops a click from notifying a tracking server (ping attribute).

opt_allowReferralMarketing_desc.message: Keeps referral codes such as Amazon’s tag= so the referrer still gets the commission.

opt_showBadge_desc.message: Shows how many cleanups were done in the current tab.

opt_contextMenus_desc.message: Adds “Copy clean link” and “Open clean link in new tab”.

opt_etagRemoval_desc.message: Prevents tracking through the browser cache. Some pages may load a little slower.

opt_skipLocalHosts_desc.message: Leaves addresses such as localhost and 192.168.x.x alone.

opt_cleanSubresources_desc.message: Applies the rules to scripts, images and API calls, not just pages. May break some sites.

opt_extraRules_desc.message: Adds more parameters and sites to ClearURLs (TikTok, Threads, Temu, Shein, Mercado Livre, Bing, Yahoo…).

opt_autoUpdateRules_desc.message: Downloads the official ClearURLs list and checks its SHA-256 hash before using it.

opt_logEnabled_desc.message: Keeps the last 300 cleaned items on this computer only, so you can check what was changed.

rulesUpToDate.message: Rules are already up to date.

rulesBundledInUse.message: Using the rules bundled with the extension.

rulesCustomHelp.message: JSON in the ClearURLs format. Use "providers" for new sites, "extend" to add parameters to an existing site (e.g. "globalRules") and "disable" to turn a site off.

rulesCustomReplaceConfirm.message: This replaces what is in the field. Click again to confirm.

pausedLead.message: LinkLimpo changes nothing on these sites. Useful when a site stops working without its parameters.

pausedEmpty.message: No paused sites. You can also pause a site from the extension icon.

logDisabled.message: The log is off. Turn it on above to see each cleaned item.

blockedWhy.message: $1 is on the list of tracking domains ($2).

blockedHint.message: “Open anyway” allows this domain until you close the browser.

protectionLead.message: Choose what LinkLimpo does on every page. Changes apply right away.

heroTitle.message: Anything that only exists to track you leaves the link.

heroText.message: The address keeps working the same: only tracking parameters are removed, before the page loads.

heroTextOff.message: Links are opening with tracking. Turn protection on with the switch above.

rulesLead.message: Rules tell which parameters and domains track you. The base is the ClearURLs list, plus LinkLimpo extra rules and your own.

activityResetConfirm.message: Click again to reset the counters.

sideCredit.message: Rules from the ClearURLs project, LGPL-3.0 license.
